name: Vedanthangal Sanctuary Gate Snack Stalls
signature_dish: Hot bajji and masala tea at the sanctuary gate
why_it_matters: There is no restaurant at Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary itself — the only food at the gate is a cluster of small stalls selling traditional Tamil snacks: bajji, masala tea, vadai, and seasonal fruit like nongu (ice apple), guava and palm sugarcane. Multiple visitor guides advise carrying your own food, as eating-in from home is permitted on the grounds.
insider_tip: Carry a packed picnic — the sanctuary explicitly allows home-brought food and there is no proper restaurant nearby. The gate stalls are fine for tea and a bajji while birdwatching but not a full meal. Visit early morning for the birds; stalls open later. Small cash only.
signature_address: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary entrance, Vedanthangal, Madurantakam Taluk, Kanchipuram District, Tamil Nadu 603314

name: Hotel Vasantha Bhavan, Madurantakam
area: Car Street, near Madurantakam Bus Stand (12km gateway)
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and meals — idli, dosa, lunch thali
why_it_matters: A pure-vegetarian South Indian eatery on Car Street by the Madurantakam bus stand — the nearest proper sit-down restaurant to Vedanthangal, about 12km away. With no real dining at the sanctuary, Madurantakam is where most visitors stop for a tiffin breakfast before the birds or a meal afterwards.
insider_tip: The realistic meal stop on a Vedanthangal trip — eat here on the way in for breakfast since the sanctuary is best at dawn. Standard reliable South Indian tiffin. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Car Street, near Bus Stand, Madurantakam, Kanchipuram District, Tamil Nadu 603306

name: A2B - Adyar Ananda Bhavan, GST Road
area: GST Road, Singaperumalkoil / Chengalpattu (gateway en route)
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and sweets — dosa, idli, mysore pak
why_it_matters: An outlet of the Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) vegetarian chain on the GST Road corridor near Chengalpattu — the cleanest, most reliable meal-and-sweets stop on the highway approach to Vedanthangal from Chennai, useful given how thin dining is right at the sanctuary.
insider_tip: Most Vedanthangal trips run from Chennai down the GST Road — fold a meal in here on the way. The sweet counter is good for picking up mysore pak. Open 7am-11pm with parking. Cash + cards + UPI.
signature_address: No 2 GST Road, Singaperumalkoil, Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu 603204
